q1.explanationZh: 第一段说网球比赛不会以平局结束，所以说法错误。

evidence.quote: a match will never end in a “tie”

q2.explanationZh: 文章说 Love 的意思是“零”，不是“比赛结束”。

q3.explanationZh: 赢3分得到“40”分，和文章一样，所以说法正确。

evidence.quote: if he wins 3 points, he is given “40” game points

q4.explanationZh: 最后一句说要赢下比赛，至少要赢2盘，所以说法正确。

evidence.quote: to win the match, a player must win no less than 2 sets

q5.explanationZh: 第二段说赢一局至少要得4分。

evidence.quote: To win a game, a tennis player must earn at least four points.

q6.explanationZh: 第三段说赢1分就得到“15”分。

evidence.quote: if a player wins a point, he is given “15” game points

q7.explanationZh: 最后一段说要赢一盘，至少要打6局。

evidence.quote: A tennis player must play at least 6 games to win a set.
